newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-MUIR PICKED FOR INJURY-HIT BOK SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-MUIR PICKED FOR INJURY-HIT BOK SQUAD.

text.p: Natal centre Dick Muir will replace Danie van Schalkwyk in the Springbok squad after the Northern Transvaal player was forced out by injury, the South African Rugby Football Union said on Wednesday.
A statement said van Schalkwyk suffered a recurrence of a groin strain during training on Tuesday, becoming the fourth member of the original touring team to drop out through injury.
Muir played in the victorious Natal team in the Currie Cup final against Transvaal last Saturday. The South African squad leaves for Argentina on Thursday.
